english.note: Use this for the common powdered chemical raising agent used in baking, especially baking powder.

examples.english: When I bake a cake, I add a little leavening to make it fluffier.
examples.traditional: 我整蛋糕嗰陣會加少少發粉，等佢鬆啲。
